name: flag
layout: horizontal strip, one slice per frame
y_offset_note: in source pixels; multiply by your draw scale (e.g. scale 4 -> 4 px per slice, draw each slice 4x at 1 px steps to fill gaps)
y_squash_note: authored at squash 1.0; the game applies SS_SQUASH = 0.62 at render time
pivot_note: rotate every slice about its centre; the stack base sits at the pivot of slice 0
palette: Phill player-ref: black pole, blue (0,0,244) and cream (251,230,201) cloth
note: Phill's flag; replaces the official v1 red flag as the tile marker in 3D World and in 2D (see flag-2d.png)
